subject.title: fix(deepinfra): use OpenAI video end point and tag DeepSeek thinking format

question: May this release retire custom DeepInfra native video endpoints and require those operators to configure an OpenAI-compatible baseUrl manually?
rationale: The branch cannot safely infer that an arbitrary custom /v1/inference host implements the different asynchronous OpenAI videos protocol, so preserving or retiring that shipped behavior requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept Documented Retirement
options.body: Merge the canonical endpoint implementation with automatic repair for DeepInfra’s official host and a clear doctor notice for custom hosts.

options.title: Preserve Native Protocol
options.body: Require a separate explicit native-video runtime path and compatibility tests, accepting two long-term protocols and configuration meanings.

options.title: Split The Changes
options.body: Land the DeepSeek dialect correction separately and defer the video endpoint migration until the compatibility contract is settled.

recommendation.title: Accept Documented Retirement
recommendation.body: Merge the canonical endpoint implementation with automatic repair for DeepInfra’s official host and a clear doctor notice for custom hosts.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is a shipped configuration and upgrade-policy decision, and this owner was directly brought into the PR review.
